Corpse.Description: Has a 75% chance to place one target in the doom state.

Black Magic Amp.Description: Raise the MP cost of black magic by 1.5 times, and raise its damage by 1.25 times. This can be set at the same time as Max Black Magic.

Exterminate.Description: Deal a tremendous amount of dark damage to all allies and enemies who are in the poison state.

Absorb M.Damage.Description: Recover HP equal to 25% of the damage taken from a magic attack. This effect is not triggered by damage from poison, nor by damage that results in a K.O.

Twilight.Description: Instantly slay all allies and enemies who are in the sleep state. Note that this will not work on certain enemies, such as bosses.

Save BM MP.Description: Lower the MP cost of black magic by 25%.

Sacrifice.Description: Sacrifice 25% of your maximum HP to raise your magic attack by 50% for three turns. *The upper limit for M.Atk is 150%.

Zero.Description: Raise the damage of magic attacks to 1.5 times normal when the last digit of your current MP is 0.

Convergence.Description: Increase the damage of magic that can only be group-cast to 1.5 times normal by narrowing its focus to a single target.

Annihilation.Description: Unleash a dark-based magic attack on all allies and enemies with -1 BP or less. Note that the lower the target's BP, the more damage will be dealt.

Status Ailment Amp.Description: Raise the chances of imparting a status ailment.

Iniquity.Description: Unleash a dark-based magic attack on all allies and enemies with 1 BP or more. Note that the higher the target's BP, the more damage will be dealt.

Max Black Magic.Description: The MP cost of black magic doubles, but it also does 1.5 times more damage. This can be set at the same time as Black Magic Amp.

Black Magic Lv.1.Description: Enables the use of level 1 black magic: Fire, Blizzard, and Thunder. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

Rod Lore.Description: Raise arms aptitude for rods to S.

Black Magic Lv.2.Description: Enables the use of level 2 black magic: Silence, Poison, and Sleep. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

Abate Fire.Description: Reduce damage taken from fire attacks. Note that you will not receive further reduction if this ability is used along with items with similar effects. Fire nullification effects take precedence over reduction effects.

Damage Dispersion.Description: Disperse 15% of damage to each ally when hit by a single-target attack and sustain the remaining damage yourself. Does not apply to magic damage reflected by Reflect .

Silence Immunity.Description: Confer immunity to silence during battles.

Black Magic Lv.3.Description: Enables the use of level 3 black magic: Fira, Blizzara, and Thundara. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

Black Resonance.Description: Black magic damage rises with each ally (excluding yourself) on which Black Resonance has been set. 0 allies with Black Resonance: No effect 1 ally with Black Resonance: Damage x1.1 2 allies with Black Resonance: Damage x1.15 3 allies with Black Resonance: Damage x1.2

Black Magic Lv.4.Description: Enables the use of level 4 black magic: Drain, Aspir, and Fear. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

Black Magic Lv.5.Description: Enables the use of level 5 black magic: Firaga, Blizzaga, and Thundaga. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

Pierce M.Defense.Description: Ignore the target's Magic Defense when dealing magic damage.

Black Magic Lv.6.Description: Enables the use of level 6 black magic: Dark, Kill, and Death. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

Group-Cast All.Description: Enable group-casting even for normally non-group-cast magic. However, this does not apply to magic targeting yourself.

Invocation Lv.1.Description: Enables the use of level 1 invocation: Girtablulu.

Steady MP Recover.Description: Recover 30 MP at the end of each turn.

Invocation Lv.2.Description: Enables the use of level 2 invocation: Hresvelgr. Note that this cannot be used without finding the appropriate summon.

Critical MP Recover.Description: Recover 200 MP when your HP falls below 20%.

Invocation Lv.3.Description: Enables the use of level 3 invocation: Ziusudra's Sin. Note that this cannot be used without finding the appropriate summon.

Save SM MP.Description: Lower the MP cost of summon magic by 25%.

Post-Battle MP.Description: Recover 25% of your maximum MP at the end of a battle.

Invocation Lv.4.Description: Enables the use of level 4 invocation: Promethean Fire. Note that this cannot be used without finding the appropriate summon.

Obliterate.Description: Cause instant death at the start of battle to targets twenty or more levels lower than you. Note that you will still get the usual pg, experience, JP, and items at the end of the battle. This will not work on certain enemies such as bosses.

Invocation Lv.5.Description: Enables the use of level 5 invocation: Deus Ex. Note that this cannot be used without finding the appropriate summon.

Max Summoning.Description: MP cost of summon magic doubles, but it also does 1.5 times more damage. This can be set at the same time as Summoning Amp.

Invocation Lv.6.Description: Enables the use of level 6 invocation: Susano-o. Note that this cannot be used without finding the appropriate summon.

Experience Up.Description: Gain x1.5 more EXP from battles.

Dark Bane.Description: Sacrifice 20% of your maximum HP to unleash a dark physical attack on one target that deals 1.25 times the damage of a conventional attack.

Abate Dark.Description: Reduce the damage taken from dark attacks. Note that you will not receive further reduction if this ability is used along with items with similar effects. Dark nullification effects take precedence over reduction effects.

Adversity.Description: Your physical attack, magic attack, physical defense, and magic defense each rise by 10% for three turns each time you accumulate damage equal to 25% of your maximum HP. *The upper limit for P.Atk, M.Atk, P.Def, M.Def is 150%.

Demon Master.Description: Charm one target of the demonkind family.

See You in Hell.Description: Deal four times the damage of a conventional attack to all enemies when you suffer a K.O. Note that this will not activate while reraise is in effect.

Minus Strike.Description: Damage one target by an amount equal to the number of HP you have lost.

Helm Lore.Description: Raise armor aptitude for helms to S.

Black Bane.Description: Sacrifice 30% of your maximum HP to unleash a dark physical attack on all enemies that deals 1.5 times the damage of a conventional attack.

Gloom.Description: The damage dealt by dark attacks rises 1.25 times, regardless of whether it is from a weapon, magic, or an ability.

Absorb Magic.Description: Start at the beginning of a turn to nullify damage from magic attacks during that turn and restore your MP by the amount of MP used to attack you. Does not apply to reflected magic damage.

Dark Nebula.Description: Sacrifice 20% of your maximum HP to unleash a dark physical attack on all allies and enemies that deals four times the damage of a conventional attack.

Life or Death.Description: Your physical attack magic attack, physical defense, and magic defense rise 50% for four turns, but you enter the doomed state. *The upper limit for P.Atk, M.Atk, P.Def, M.Def is 150%.

Rage.Description: Repeats Dark Bane on a random enemy target until HP is 1, or up to 5 times.

Examine.Description: Display enemy information, including HP, elemental weakness and family. Once you have examined a certain enemy, move the Circle Pad left at any time to view the information again. You can also select the enemy to view its current stats. Current HP can be reviewed by moving the Circle Pad left.

Treat.Description: Restore the HP of one ally by 20%. Note that this ability can even be used in the silence state.

Divining Rod.Description: Displays the number of unopened treasure chests within a dungeon on the map screen.

Dungeon Master.Description: Avoid damage and status ailments from tricks, traps, and other dungeon devices. Note that this effects applies to all allies.

Mislead.Description: Lower your chances of being targeted by enemies to the lowest level possible.

Prayer.Description: Make chance-based abilities 1.5 times more likely to succeed for ten turns.

Endure.Description: Raise your physical defense and magic defense by 25% for four turns. The upper limit for P.Def and M.Def is 150%.

Poison Immunity.Description: Confer immunity to poison during battles.

JP Up.Description: Earn 1.2 times the normal amount of job points. Note that this effect does not stack with similar effects from items.

Flee.Description: Always succeed in escaping from battle. However, this will not work in certain battles or areas.

Lure Enemy.Description: Double the enemy encounter rate. Note that effects from the same ability do not stack.

Stand Ground.Description: Has a 75% chance to survive with 1 HP when suffering damage that would result in K.O. Note that this will not happen if HP is already at 1.

Mimic.Description: Imitate the previous command without expending HP, MP, BP, pg or items.

Stomp.Description: Deal damage 1.25 times that of a conventional attack. However, your physical defense and magic defense will decrease by 25% for two turns. The lower limit for P.Def and M.Def is 75%.

Two-Handed.Description: Double a weapon's Physical Attack when swords/axes/spears/staves/katanas are held in both hands. (One hand must be free before this will take effect).

Ironclad.Description: Start at the beginning of a turn to raise your physical defense to the maximum level for the entire turn. The upper limit for P.Def is 150%.

Protect Ally.Description: If an ally with less than 20% of HP left takes a single-target attack, you will take the attack instead.

Shield Strike.Description: Deal the same damage as a conventional attack and for two turns, raise physical defense by 25%. Available only when equipping a shield. The upper limit for P.Def is 150%.

Shield Lore.Description: Raise armor aptitude for shields to S.

Vengeance.Description: Unleash a physical attack on all enemies. The more of your allies are in K.O. state, the more powerful your attack will be. 0 K.O. allies: 0.75x conventional attack 1 K.O. ally: 1.5x conventional attack 2 K.O. allies: 2x conventional attack 3 K.O. allies: 2.5x conventional attack

Sword Lore.Description: Raise arms aptitude for swords to S.

Full Cover.Description: During the entire turn this is used, when the specified ally takes a single-target physical attack, you will take the hit instead, but only suffer half the damage.

Dual Shields.Description: Equip a shield on both arms.

Chivalrous Spirit.Description: Raise Physical Defense by 25% for five turns each time Protect Ally, Full Cover, or White Knight is used. The upper limit for P.Def is 150%.

Super Charge.Description: Make an attack based off physical defense at 200% strength.

Pay to Play.Description: Spend your level times 50 pg to raise the target's Critical Rate by 300% for four turns. *The upper limit for Crit Rate is 1000%.

Salesman.Description: Make an enemy buy a recovery item from you at 2.4 times the selling price. Note that the success rate of the sale depends on the item.

White Knight.Description: The ally with the most HP protects you when you suffer a single-target physical while your HP is below 20%.

Pharmacy.Description: Purchase a recovery item and use it on one target.

Hedge Risk.Description: Halve the damage you suffer for five turns by spending money equal to half the damage.

Takeover.Description: Spend your level times 50 pg to deal damage to one target that is equal to the money spent.

BP Drink.Description: Purchase a BP recovery item and use it on one target. Small BP drink (restores 1 BP): 1,000 pg Medium BP drink (restores 2 BP): 10,000 pg Large BP drink (restores 3 BP): 100,000 pg

Speculate.Description: Has a 50% chance to deal double damage and a 50% chance to deal none.

More Money.Description: Earn 1.5 times more money than normal after a battle. Note that this effect does not stack with similar effects from items, but the bonus from multiple characters using this ability does stack.

Millionaire.Description: Use this ability with the Send command to gift an amount equal to your level times 25 pg to a friend who summons this action using Summon Friend.

Big Pharma.Description: Restore one enemy's HP and make the target pay pg equal to the number of HP recovered.

Full Leverage.Description: For five turns, damage, recovery, and the HP/MP/BP required for actions will be double the usual for all allies and enemies.

Low Leverage.Description: For five turns, damage, recovery, and the HP/MP/BP required for actions will be half the usual for all allies and enemies.

Payoff.Description: Spend money to buy off the enemy and end the battle. (You still get pg, exp, JP and items.)

Strong Strike.Description: Deal double the damage of a conventional attack to one target, but there is a 50% chance that the attack will miss.

Invigorate.Description: Raise your physical attack by 25% for two turns. However, there is a 25% chance of failure, in which case you will take damage equal to 20% your maximum HP. *The upper limit for P.Atk is 150%.

Inner Alchemy.Description: Cure yourself of the status ailments poison, blind, silence, dread, and confuse.

Knuckle Lore.Description: Raise arms aptitude for knuckles to S. In addition, when no weapons are equipped, a value equal to two times your level will be added to your Physical Attack.

Hidden Dragon.Description: Attack at the end of the turn, but deal 1.25 time the damage of a conventional attack to one target.

Qigong Wave.Description: Ignore Default's damage reduction effect and deal 1.25 times the damage of a conventional attack to one target.

Blind Immunity.Description: Confer immunity to blind during battles.

Pressure Point.Description: Ignore the target's physical defense and deal 2 times the damage of a conventional attack to one target.

Phoenix Flight.Description: Reduce your HP to 1 and convert the amount of HP sacrificed into damage applied to a single enemy.

Natural Talent.Description: Physical Attack increases by 100% when nothing is equipped (both hands, head, body and accessories).

Shippûjinrai.Description: Attack at the start of the turn and deal the same damage as a conventional attack.

Transience.Description: Evade an attack and counterattack, dealing the same damage as a conventional attack.

Utsusemi.Description: Evade a physical attack one time.

Comeback Kid.Description: Magic Attack and Physical Attack each rise 25% for three turns with each physical attack evaded. *The upper limit for P.Atk and M.Atk is 150%.

Ikkikasei.Description: Raise the number of attacks by 100% for that turn only. The upper limit for Hit Count is 200%.

Cleave.Description: Has a chance to perform an additional attack after defeating a target with a conventional attack. Note that the chance goes up the more damage you deal in relation to the defeated target's remaining HP.

Shunshin.Description: Raise evasion to maximum for six turns. *The upper limit for evasion is 150%.

Kairai.Description: The target of the enemy's single-target attack will be the ally you select, but only for the turn in which the ability is used.

Dual Wield.Description: When equipping a weapon in each hand, normally only 50% of the weapons' Physical Attack is applied to the characters' Physical Attack. This support ability allows 100% to be applied.

Kakuremi.Description: Lower your chances of being targeted by enemies to the lowest level possible for five turns.

Frenetic Fighting.Description: Extend user's hit count from 16 to 32.

Love Power.Description: Raise all targets' physical attack by 25% for four turns. *The upper limit for P.Atk is 150%.

Love Rush.Description: Raise all targets' speed by 25% for four turns. *The upper limit for speed is 150%.

One More for You.Description: Raise one target's BP by one.

Got Your Back.Description: Raise all targets' physical defense by 25% for four turns. *The upper limit for P.Def is 150%.

Key to Your Heart.Description: Raise all targets' magic defense by 25% for four turns. *The upper limit for M.Def is 150%.

Support Amp.Description: Add 10% to the stat-raising effects you receive, and subtract 10% from stat-lowering effects.

Little Devil.Description: Raise all targets' magic attack by 25% for four turns. *The upper limit for M.Atk is 150%.

Catch Me.Description: Raise your chances of being targeted by enemies to the highest level possible for five turns.

Buff Up.Description: Your Physical Attack, Magic Attack, Physical Defense, and Magic Defense each rise 5% for five turns at the end of each turn. *The upper limit for P.Atk, M.Atk, P.Def, and M.Def is 150%.

Prolong Support.Description: Double the number of turns that stat-raising effects on yourself last.

Charm Immunity.Description: Confer immunity to charm during battles.

Save Singing MP.Description: Lower the MP cost of Singing by 50%.

Zero Sum.Description: Reduce BP to zero for either all enemies or all allies who have one or more BP.

Double Damage.Description: Deal two times the damage of a conventional attack to one target.

Provoke.Description: Raise your chances of being targeted by enemies to the highest level possible.

Shell Split.Description: Deal the same damage as a conventional attack to one target, and for four turns, lower the target's physical defense by 25%. *The lower limit for P.Def is 75%.

Scale Strip.Description: Deal the same damage as a conventional attack to one target, and for four turns, lower the target's magical defense by 25%. *The lower limit for M.Def is 75%.

Shin Smash.Description: Deal the same damage as a conventional attack to one target, and for four turns, lower the target's speed by 25%. *The lower limit for speed is 75%.

Mass Attack.Description: Allies with less than 20% of their HP left attack at the same time you do. Note that this does not end the turn for the allies that join in the attack. They can still perform an action during that turn.

Berserk.Description: Raise physical attack by 50% and continue to making conventional attacks for six turns. *Berserk's P.Atk increase does not stack with other P.Atk boost effects.

Adrenaline Rush.Description: Physical Attack and Physical Defense each rise by 50% for five turns when your HP falls below 20%. *The upper limit for P.Atk and P.Def is 150%.

Defang.Description: Deal the same damage as a conventional attack to one target, and for four turns, lower the target's physical attack by 25%. *The lower limit for P.Atk is 75%.

Skull Bash.Description: Deal the same damage as a conventional attack to one target, and for four turns, lower the target's magic attack by 25%. The lower limit for M.Atk is 75%.

Axe Lore.Description: Raise arms aptitude for axes to S.

Torrent.Description: Unleash physical water attacks dealing 0.3 times the damage of a conventional attack up to 16 times on one target.

Targeting.Description: Deal 1.25 times the damage of a conventional attack.

Bug Slayer.Description: Deal 1.5 times the damage of a conventional attack to members of the bug family.

Plant Slayer.Description: Deal 1.5 times the damage of a conventional attack to members of the plant family.

Beast Slayer.Description: Deal 1.5 times the damage of a conventional attack to members of the beast family.

Paralyze Immunity.Description: Confer immunity to paralysis during battles.

Aerial Slayer.Description: Deal 1.5 times the damage of a conventional attack to members of the aerial family.

Aquatic Slayer.Description: Deal 1.5 times the damage of a conventional attack to members of the aquatic family.

Bow Lore.Description: Raise arms aptitude for bows to S.

Dragon Slayer.Description: Deal 1.5 times the damage of a conventional attack to members of the dragonkind family.

Undead Slayer.Description: Deal 1.5 times the damage of a conventional attack to members of the undead family.

Demon Slayer.Description: Deal 1.5 times the damage of a conventional attack to members of the demonkind family.

Precision.Description: When all conventional attacks hit, damage will rise according to the number of attacks. Specifically, damage is increased by 3% for each attack.

Multiburst.Description: Unleash four physical attacks that randomly target enemies, dealing 0.6 times the damage of a conventional attack.

B/W Magic Lv.1.Description: Enables use of level 1 white magic and black magic: Cure, Poisona, Blindna, Fire, Blizzard, and Thunder. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

B/W Magic Lv.2.Description: Enables use of level 2 white magic and black magic: Protect, Shell, Aero, Silence, Poison, and Sleep. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

Turn Tables.Description: Raise BP by one when evading an enemy attack.

MP Free in a Pinch.Description: MP cost falls to zero when your HP is below 20%.

B/W Magic Lv.3.Description: Enables use of level 3 white magic and black magic: Cura, Raise, Esuna, Fira, Blizzara, and Thundara. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

Adrenaline.Description: BP rises by one when your attack defeats an enemy. Note that if you simultaneously defeat multiple enemies, your BP rises by the number of enemies defeated.

Save Magic MP.Description: Lower the MP cost of black, white, time, and summon magic by 25%.

BP Recovery.Description: Raise BP by two when sustaining a status ailment.

B/W Magic Lv.4.Description: Enables use of level 4 white magic and black magic: Reflect, Dispel, Aerora, Drain, Aspir, and Fear. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

Revenge.Description: Has a 25% chance to increase BP by one when taking damage. Poison damage does not trigger this ability.

Revival.Description: Has a 75% chance to raise your BP by two when your HP falls below 20%. Using abilities that consume your own HP does not trigger this ability, however.

An Eye for an Eye.Description: When your HP falls below 20%, the chance of scoring a critical hit will rise by 900% for five turns.

In the Red.Description: Increases Magic Damage when you have negative BP.

Compounding.Description: Combine two items to obtain a special effect.

First Aid.Description: Restore HP to the ally with the lowest HP at the end of the turn. Note that this ability can even be used in the silence state.

Experiment.Description: Transform a consumable item into an attack item.

Attack Item Amp.Description: Raise the damage dealt by attack items to 1.5 times normal.

Inoculate.Description: Use a consumable item that cures a status ailment on one target to confer immunity to that status ailment for six turns. Note that this ability can even be used in the silence state.

Auto-Potion.Description: Automatically use a potion on yourself when you take damage. Note that you must have a potion for this to occur.

Shorten Ailment.Description: The chance of the status ailments sleep, paralyze, dread, confuse, charm, and stop being naturally cured at the start of each turn rises to 50% higher than normal.

Widen Area.Description: Use an item and apply its effects to all targets.

Healing Lore.Description: Double the effectiveness of recovery effects when you use magic, abilities, or items to restore HP or MP.

Turn Toxic.Description: Inflict poison and deal damage to one target equal to the recovery amount of a recovery item.

Auto Phoenix.Description: Automatically use a phoenix down if an ally is in the K.O. state during the last command in your turn. Note that this will not occur if you do not have a phoenix down. *Will not activate during Bravely Second.

Collect.Description: Get an item during a battle. Note that the items you get differ by location.

Resurrect.Description: Resurrect all K.O. allies and restore 25% of their maximum HP. Note that this ability can even be used in the silence state.

Feel No Pain.Description: HP will not fall for two turns after the start of a battle, even when taking damage. But at the end of the second turn, any damage taken will be subtracted from HP all at once. Note that damage in this case cannot be reduced.

Sword Magic Lv.1.Description: Enables the use of level 1 sword magic: Fire, Blizzard, and Thunder. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

Sword Magic Lv.2.Description: Enables the use of level 2 sword magic: Silence, Poison, and Sleep. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

Firewall.Description: Has a 50% chance to counterattack with fire damage when hit with a single-target physical attack.

Sword Magic Lv.3.Description: Enables the use of level 3 sword magic: Fira, Blizzara, and Thundara. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

Auto-Aspir Blade.Description: Imbue a weapon with an MP absorb effect for ten turns, starting from the beginning of the battle. Attacks with this weapon absorb the target's MP. Note that this can be overwritten by other sword magic.

Magic Armor.Description: When using elemental sword magic, damage from the element in use is reduced for four turns.

Sword Magic Lv.4.Description: Enables the use of level 4 sword magic: Drain, Aspir, and Fear. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

Memento.Description: Restore 50% of MP for all allies except yourself when you suffer a K.O. However, allies in the K.O. state do not recover MP. Except during Bravely Second, the upper limit for MP restoration is 999.

Sword Magic Lv.5.Description: Enables the use of level 5 sword magic: Firaga, Blizzaga, and Thundaga. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

Anti-Magic.Description: Raise Magic Defense by 50% for four turns when hit by a magic attack. *The upper limit for M.Def is 150%.

Sword Magic Amp.Description: The MP cost of sword magic doubles, but the damage dealt while the ability is in effect is 1.25 times greater no matter which sword magic is used.

Sword Magic Lv.6.Description: Enables the use of level 6 sword magic: Holy, Dark, and Death. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

M.Def Specialize.Description: Lower Physical Defense by 25% and raise Magic Defense by 50%.

Phantom Weapon.Description: The damage from the currently equipped weapon is added to the damage of magic attacks.

Spirit Ward.Description: All elemental damage to the selected ally is nullified for four turns.

Auto-Shell.Description: Invoke Shell on yourself for ten turns at the start of battle.

Fairy's Aid.Description: Boost the target's elemental attacks to deal 1.5 times normal damage for five turns.

Convert BP.Description: Sacrifice 25% of your maximum MP to raise your BP by two.

Save WM MP.Description: Lower the MP cost of white magic by 25%.

Adaptation.Description: The selected ally absorbs all elemental damage for four turns.

Stillness.Description: Damage to all allies and enemies will be nullified for two turns.

Holy One.Description: Lower Physical Attack by 25%, but boost the effectiveness of recovery magic by 2.5 times.

Greater Spirit Ward.Description: All elemental damage to all allies is halved for four turns.

Fairy Ward.Description: Render all allies immune to poison, blind, silence, sleep, paralyze, dread, berserk, confuse, charm, doom, death, and stop for five turns.

Moderation.Description: For all allies and enemies with 1 BP or more, reduce BP by 1, and for those with -1 BP or less, raise BP by 1.

Enigma.Description: Nullify all elemental damage taken by all allies for four turns.

Maximize HP.Description: Maximum HP doubles only during battle.

Summoning Lv. 1.Description: Enables the use of level 1 summoning: Girtablulu.

Abate Lightning.Description: Reduce damage taken from lightning attacks. Note that you will not receive further reduction if this ability is used along with items with similar effects. Lightning nullification effects take precedence over reduction effects.

Summoning Lv. 2.Description: Enables the use of level 2 summoning: Hresvelgr. Note that this cannot be used without finding the appropriate summon.

Summoning Lv. 3.Description: Enables the use of level 3 summoning: Ziusudra's Sin. Note that this cannot be used without finding the appropriate summon.

Friendship.Description: The amount that affinity goes up with one Summon Friend doubles.

Summoning Amp.Description: Raise the MP cost of summon magic by 1.25 times, and raise its damage by 1.25 times. This can be set at the same time as Max Summoning.

Summoning Lv.4.Description: Enables the use of level 4 summoning: Promethean Fire. Note that this cannot be used without finding the appropriate summon.

Summoning Lv. 5.Description: Enables the use of level 5 summoning: Deus Ex. Note that this cannot be used without finding the appropriate summon.

Summon Substitute.Description: When you suffer a K.O., random summon magic that you have learned is invoked without consuming any MP. Note that this effect will not occur during reraise or in the case of a K.O. from poison damage.

Summoning Lv. 6.Description: Enables the use of level 6 summoning: Susano-o. Note that this cannot be used without finding the appropriate summon.

Convert MP.Description: Restore MP equal to 1% of the damage sustained. This effect is not triggered by damage from poison .

Summoning Surge.Description: Each time summon magic is used in combat, the damage it does rises by 10%. Note that the same summon magic does not have to be used for this to take effect.

Summon in Pinch.Description: When your HP falls below 20%, summon magic that you have learned is randomly invoked without consuming any MP. Note that this effect is not triggered by poison damage.

Amp Friends.Description: Enhances the effect of Friend Summons.

Nothing Ventured.Description: Halve the damage you sustain if hit by a physical attack during the turn this ability is used and counterattack with double the damage of a conventional attack.

Abate Earth.Description: Reduce damage taken from earth attacks. Note that you will not receive further reduction if this ability is used along with items with similar effects. Earth nullification effect take precedence over reduction effects.

Katana Lore.Description: Raise arms aptitude for katanas to S.

Squeaky Wheel.Description: Reduce the target's BP by one. For bosses and some enemies, the success rate falls to 30%.

Multitask.Description: Has a 25% chance to follow up with an additional attack when making a conventional attack.

Counter.Description: Has a 60% chance to counterattack, when taking a single-target physical attack, and deal the same damage as a conventional attack.

Confusion Immunity.Description: Confer immunity to confusion during battles.

Before Swine.Description: Halve the damage you sustain if hit by a magic attack during the turn this ability is used and counterattack with three times the damage of a conventional attack. Does not apply to reflected magic damage.

Counter Amp.Description: Raise the damage dealt by counterattacks to 1.5 times normal. This is effective even for counterattacks other than the swordmaster's.

Know Thine Enemy.Description: Counterattack with four times the damage of a conventional attack if hit by a single-target attack from the selected enemy the turn this ability is used.

Redoubled Effort.Description: The higher your BP, the more the power of your physical attacks rises. 0 BP or less: no effect 1 BP: x1.1 2 BP: x1.21 3 BP: x1.33 4 BP: x1.46

The Worm Turns.Description: Counterattack with 7.5 times the damage of a conventional attack if hit by an enemy attack when your HP is below 20% during the the turn this ability is used. Does not apply to reflected magic damage.

Slow and Steady.Description: Raise Speed to maximum for two turns when using Default. The upper limit for Speed is 150%.

Free Lunch.Description: For two turns, there is no MP cost.

Heart Strike.Description: Unleash an attack for a guaranteed critical hit that deals two times the damage of a conventional attack.

Abate Light.Description: Reduce damage taken light-elemental attacks. Note that you will not receive further reduction if this ability is used along with items with similar effects. Light nullification effects take precedence over reduction effects.

Giant Slayer.Description: Deal 1.5 times the damage of a conventional attack to one opponent with more HP than you.

Magic Critical.Description: Has a 15% chance of a critical hit when using magic. A critical hit will double the amount of damage or recovery.

Default Guard.Description: Reduce the amount of damage received during Default by 75%.

Rampart.Description: Form a shield around all allies that prevents one physical attack.

Item Critical.Description: Has a 15% chance of a critical hit when using an item. A critical hit will double the amount of damage or recovery.

Radiant Blast.Description: Unleash a light-based physical attack on one target that ignores Default's damage reduction effect and deals 1.5 times the damage of a conventional attack.

Critical Amp.Description: The damage dealt from critical hits will be 2.5 times normal. Note that this effect applies to magic and item critical hits as well.

BP Limit Up.Description: Raise the BP limit by one, up to a maximum of 4.

Desperation.Description: Attack by adding the value of your physical defense to your physical attack. However, your physical defense will be reduced to minimum for that turn. *The lower limit for P.Def is 75%.

Armor Lore.Description: Raise aptitude for armor to S.

Heaven's Gate.Description: Make a number of random light elemental attacks equal to BP.

Steal.Description: Has a 25% chance to steal an item from an enemy.

Abate Wind.Description: Reduce damage taken from wind attacks. Note that you will not receive further reduction if this ability is used along with items with similar effects. Wind nullification effects take precedence over reduction effects.

Life Thief.Description: Deal the same damage as a conventional attack to one target. Also has a 75% chance to restore your own HP by the amount of the damage dealt.

Mug.Description: Deal the same damage as a conventional attack to one target. Also has a 25% chance to steal an item from that target.

Raid.Description: Raises all allies' BP by one when the party gets first strike or gains a +1 BP bonus at the start of battle.

Dagger Lore.Description: Raise arms aptitude for daggers to S.

Godspeed Strike.Description: Unleash an attack that substitutes speed for physical attack and ignores enemies' physical defense.

Master Thief.Description: Doubles the success rate of stealing abilities. Note that this effect does not stack with similar effects from items.

Rob Blind.Description: Nab two items instead of one when stealing.

Shake Down.Description: Steal an item from all enemies with a 25% success rate for each.

Burgle and Buff.Description: Raise physical attack by 25% when stealing an item from an enemy or recovering HP with Life Thief.

Time Magic Lv.1.Description: Enables the use of level 1 time magic: Slow, Regen, and Quake. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

Slow Parry.Description: Has a 50% chance to apply slow to your attacker when taking a single-target physical attack.

Time Magic Lv.2.Description: Enables the use of level 2 Time magic: Haste, Teleport, and Quara. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

Time Slip.Description: Return to the start of a battle if the entire party is wiped out. Note that even if multiple characters have this support ability, the effect only occurs once per battle. *SP is not returned.

Time Magic Lv.3.Description: Enables the use of level 3 Time Magic: Gravity, Veil, and Slowga. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

Stop Immunity.Description: Confer immunity to stop during battles.

Time Magic Lv.4.Description: Enables the use of level 4 Time Magic: Hastega, Veilga, and Comet. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

Save TM MP.Description: Lower the MP cost of time magic by 25%.

Time Magic Lv.5.Description: Enables the use of level 5 Time Magic: Quick, Stop, and Quaga. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

Slow World.Description: Lower the BP of all allies and enemies by one once every two turns. This works even if the character with this support ability is in the K.O. state.

Time Magic Lv.6.Description: Enables the use of level 6 Time Magic: Graviga, Reraise, and Meteor. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

Hasten World.Description: All enemies and allies gain one BP at end of turn.

Crescent Moon.Description: Unleash a physical attack on all enemies that deals the same damage as a conventional attack.

Jump.Description: Jump out of the screen at the end of the turn and then come hurtling down during the next turn, dealing two times the damage of a conventional attack. Note the damage is tripled if a spear is equipped.

Land.Description: Land is associated with jumping, a failed Jump will return the user to their original position due to the lack of a valid target.

Spear Lore.Description: Raise arms aptitude for spears to S.

Judgement.Description: Deal three times the damage of a conventional attack to one target.

Spirit Barrier.Description: Become impervious to damage for ten turns by sacrificing MP equal to 10% of the damage you suffered.

Soul Crush.Description: Reduce one enemy's MP by 10% of the damage dealt by a conventional attack.

BP Skill Amp.Description: The BP cost of abilities activated by BP use rises by one, but the damage they deal also increases by 1.5 times.

Decimate.Description: Allies and enemies with 10% or less HP remaining will each suffer damage equal to their own remaining HP.

High Jump.Description: Jump out of the screen and come hurtling down in the next turn, dealing three times the damage of a conventional attack. Note that damage is increased 4.5 times if a spear is equipped.

Pierce Default.Description: Your attack's damage will not be reduced by the target's Default state.

Soul Mates.Description: Physical attack and magic attack each rise by 25% for five turns each time an ally suffers a K.O. *The upper limit for P.Atk and M.Atk is 150%.

Aerials.Description: The number of turns in the air during jump-type abilities increases by one turn, and the amount of damage dealt rises by 1.5 times. Note that the BP cost also rises by one, except for with Sky High.

Sky High.Description: Begin the battle in the air and come diving down to attack on the first turn, dealing double the damage of a conventional attack to one enemy. Note that damage is tripled if a spear is equipped.

Super Jump.Description: Leap off the screen; two turns later, come down with an attack that deals 2 times normal damage to all enemies. Note the damage is tripled if a spear is equipped.

Absorb P. Damage.Description: Restore HP equal to 30% of the damage taken from physical attacks. However, damage resulting in K.O. will not be healed.

Blood Thirst.Description: Absorb from one target an amount of HP equal to the damage dealt by a conventional attack.

Bloodlust.Description: Physical Attack, Magic Attack, Physical Defense, and Magic Defense rise by 25% for 5 turns each time you defeat an enemy with your own attack. *The upper limit for P.Atk, M.Atk, P.Def, and M.Def is 150%.

Charm.Description: Has a 75% chance to place one target in the Charm state.

Magic Thirst.Description: Absorb from one target an amount of MP equal to 10% of the damage dealt by a conventional attack.

Monster Ability Up.Description: Raise the damage dealt by genome abilities to 1.25 times normal.

Subvert.Description: Has a 50% chance to place all enemies in the charm state.

Self-Restore.Description: Fully restore your HP at the end of battle.

Absorb Stats.Description: Absorb the selected stat from one target.

Drain Attack Up.Description: Raise the damage dealt by drain attacks to 1.5 times normal. (The BP drained by Battle Thirst will be doubled.)

Genome Drain.Description: A character with this ability can learn certain enemy abilities when targeted by them.

Rise from Dead.Description: If KOed, there is a chance of reviving at the end of the turn.

White Magic Lv. 1.Description: Enables the use of level 1 white magic: Cure, Poisona, and Blindna. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

White Magic Lv. 2.Description: Enables the use of level 2 white magic: Protect, Shell, and Aero. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

Staff Lore.Description: Raise arms aptitude for staves to S.

Self-Healing.Description: Recover from poison, blind, and silence at the end of battle.

White Magic Lv. 3.Description: Enables the use of level 3 white magic: Cura, Raise, and Esuna. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

Abate Water.Description: Reduce damage taken from water attacks. Note that you will not receive further reduction if this ability is used along with items with similar effects. Water nullification effects take precedence over reduction effects.

Angelic Ward.Description: Has a 50% chance to halve the damage received, regardless of whether it is a single-target or multiple-target attacks. However, this effect does not apply to damage from poison.

White Magic Lv. 4.Description: Enables the use of level 4 white magic: Reflect, Dispel, and Aerora. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

White Magic Lv. 5.Description: Enables the use of level 5 white magic: Esunaga, Curada, and Aeroga. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

Epic Group-Cast.Description: The damage dealt and the amount of recovery do not decline when group-casting magic. Note that this effect can also be invoked from the Menu Screen.

White Magic Lv. 6.Description: Enables the use of level 6 white magic: Curaga, Arise, and Holy. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

Conservation of Life.Description: When K.O.'d, revive all allies and fully restore HP.
